photo.id: sha256 of normalized absolute path (first 24 hex)
photo.detailPath: absolute full resolution cached image or null
photo.width: original or embedded preview pixel width
photo.decisionSource: manual | automatic; legacy defaults to manual
photo.suggestionConfidence: number 0..1 | null; technical evidence, not aesthetic probability
photo.decisionTouched: boolean; false for untouched manual defaults, preserves manual Undecided eligibility through undo

project.name: string
project.includeSubfolders: boolean; saved import scope; legacy projects default to true
project.automaticSelectionEnabled: boolean; new desktop projects default true; legacy projects false

args.name: string
args.includeSubfolders: boolean; optional, defaults to false for new projects

update_photo_patches.returns: Photo[]; all patches commit atomically or none commit

args.includeDiscards: boolean; optional, defaults false for legacy callers

automatic_first_pass.returns: Project; apply available same-mode proposals or start a rescan

clear_automatic_selection.returns: Project; reset only automatic choices and disable automatic selection on future rescans

engine.scanCLI: python -m culling_engine scan --source DIR --cache DIR [--no-subfolders] [--selection-mode cautious|stronger]; recursive unless --no-subfolders; default cautious
engine.protocol: one JSON object per stdout line; diagnostics ONLY stderr; UTF-8; flush every line

records.error: {type:error,message:string,path?:string}; path-bearing records are recoverable file/directory failures, no path is a fatal scan failure
records.suggestions: {type:suggestions,suggestions:[{photoId:string,decision:favorite|pass|undecided,reason:string|null,confidence:number 0..1}]}; exactly one per analyzed photo, after groups before complete

lightroomManifest.photos: [{path:string,rating:number|null,decision:undecided|favorite|pass,tags:string[],catalogFlag:pick|reject|null,addToCollection:boolean}]; favorite maps to pick; pass maps to reject; extra project discards have addToCollection=false
lightroomManifest.legacy: Plugin accepts schema 1; favorites pick, pass does not reject, all entries join collection

principles: Original files never moved, modified, or deleted.
Manual decisions persist across rescans and reanalysis.
Automatic choices require a successful complete scan, are explained and reversible, and preserve manual review edits. Automatic selection does not assign stars.
Discard/pass and Lightroom Reject flags never delete originals.
Use a single Rust-owned SQLite database per project.
Match all JSON and Tauri argument keys in camelCase.
Frontend handles incremental refresh, errors, keyboard focus and saves without losing edits.
